players.product: winding conductor and power cable for transformers (HD Hyundai Electric supplier)

quarterly_data.signal: Submarine cable capacity: submarine cable plant 1 is operating, and plant 2, under construction with a target of starting operation in 2027, is being built as a dedicated production base able to make 640kV-class HVDC and 400kV-class HVAC submarine cable. The company's 11,000-ton cable-laying vessel Skandi Connector (which it calls Korea's largest CLV) can handle offshore wind inner and outer grids, long-distance grid connections and HVDC submarine cable, and is deployed with PALOS on domestic offshore wind projects.
quarterly_data.figure: plant 2 operation targeted for 2027; 640kV HVDC and 400kV HVAC submarine cable; 11,000-ton CLV

quarterly_data.signal: Busduct capacity: to meet rising busduct demand the company tripled the size of its busduct plant last year and added equipment; it showcased epoxy-insulated busduct whose quality and productivity were raised through new equipment, alongside PET-insulated busduct.
